title: ZooWork-ShopRanker: An Open, Preference-Aligned E-Commerce Reranker
title_zh: ZooWork-ShopRanker：一种开放的、偏好对齐的电商重排序模型
abstract_en: Open rerankers trained for general web retrieval transfer imperfectly to e-commerce, where ranking decisions depend not only on topical relevance but also on user preferences, product constraints, and comparative product fit. These preference signals are difficult to supervise at scale: real search traffic provides authentic queries and candidates but no clean pairwise labels. We present ZooWork-ShopRanker, a family of e-commerce rerankers (0.6B, 4B, and 8B) aligned to judge-labeled shopping preference. Training pairs are labeled by a panel of reasoning large language models (LLMs) from different families acting as a preference oracle, with position-debiased judgments and agreement tiers, and the rerankers are trained on these labels. The aligned 8B flagship then serves as a distillation teacher for the efficient 4B and 0.6B models, which are fit to its scores and sharpened on judged pairs. To measure progress, we introduce ShopRank-Bench, a contamination-limited benchmark of ~10,000 private-traffic preference pairs in both text formats, tiered by how many judge families committed to each label. ZooWork-ShopRanker-8B and -4B significantly outperform the strongest open reranker baseline, every model significantly beats its own un-aligned base, and ZooWork-ShopRanker-0.6B beats its size peer; the gains hold in both formats and extend to common MTEB benchmarks. We release the models and the dual-format ShopRank-Bench to facilitate further research.
abstract_zh: 面向通用网页检索训练的开放式重排序模型，在电商场景中的迁移效果有限，因为排序不仅取决于主题相关性，还依赖用户偏好、商品约束与商品间匹配度。针对真实搜索流量具有真实查询和候选商品、却缺乏高质量成对标签的问题，本文提出 ZooWork-ShopRanker 系列电商重排序模型，包括 0.6B、4B 和 8B 规模。作者利用来自不同模型家族的推理型大语言模型（LLM）组成偏好评审委员会，作为偏好预言机，对训练样本进行位置去偏判断，并按评审一致性划分等级。在此基础上训练重排序模型；随后使用对齐后的 8B 模型作为蒸馏教师，通过拟合其分数并在评审成对样本上进一步训练高效的 4B 和 0.6B 模型。为评估性能，作者提出 ShopRank-Bench，这是一个污染受限的基准，包含约 10,000 个来自私有流量的偏好成对样本，并提供两种文本格式，同时依据多个评审模型家族对标签的一致程度进行分层。实验表明，ZooWork-ShopRanker-8B 和 -4B 显著优于最强开放式重排序基线；所有模型均显著优于各自未对齐的基础模型；0.6B 模型也超过同规模模型。性能提升在两种格式及常用 MTEB 基准上均保持稳定。作者同时发布模型和双格式 ShopRank-Bench，以促进后续研究。
key_points_zh: 针对电商排序中的用户偏好、商品约束和相对匹配度，提出 ZooWork-ShopRanker 系列模型，覆盖 0.6B、4B 和 8B。
使用不同家族推理型 LLM 作为偏好预言机，结合位置去偏与一致性分层，构建更可靠的成对训练标签。
以对齐后的 8B 模型为教师进行知识蒸馏，并通过评审样本强化训练 4B 和 0.6B 模型，兼顾效果与效率。
提出约 10,000 个私有流量偏好对的双格式基准 ShopRank-Bench，并按评审家族一致性分层。
8B、4B 显著超过最强开放基线，所有模型优于未对齐版本，且收益扩展至 MTEB 等通用检索评测。

llm_assessment.comment: This work directly advances preference-aligned product reranking through judge-supervised data, distillation, and an open commerce-specific benchmark.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作通过评审模型监督、蒸馏和开放的电商专用基准，直接推动了偏好对齐的商品重排序研究。
